question: Which of the following district of Bangladesh does NOT come under the Khulna division?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coxsbazar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information:__**

 
• There are eight divisions in Bangladesh, with **Khulna Division being the second largest.**
 
• At the time of the **2011 Bangladesh census**, it had a population of **15,563,000 **and a surface area of **22,285 km² **(8,604 sq mi).
 
• Khulna City in the Khulna District serves as both its capital and largest city.
 
• **Khulna Division **was a part of the **Presidency Division **during the **British Raj**.
